title: Sheinbaum Meets Privately with Maru Campos on Her Arrival in Ciudad Juárez
author: Jesús Estrada
content:
_This article by Jesús Estrada, correspondent, originally appeared in
the[September 19, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/19/politica/sheinbaum-se-
reune-con-maru-campos-a-su-llegada-a-chihuahua), Mexico's premier left-wing
daily newspaper._

The president of Mexico, Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo, held a private meeting with
PAN Governor María Eugenia Campos Galván at midday this Saturday at the
Abraham González airport in Ciudad Juárez. The state governor and the
president addressed various issues, among them the case of the **participation
of CIA agents in operations against drug trafficking** , two of whom died in a
car accident in the municipality of Morelos this past April.

As she left the airport to head to the "Honesty and Results" event at the
Plaza de la Mexicanidad, Claudia Sheinbaum confirmed that she had spoken with
Maru Campos about the alleged illegal intervention of U.S. agents. "We spoke
about coordination; what I told her is that in the event there was a violation
of any law, action must be taken — she agreed — in case any official of her
government acted wrongly, that it proceed."

The agreement with the governor of Chihuahua was that, "through the
Secretariat of Governance and the Secretariat of Security, depending on the
issue, we will work jointly for the well-being of the state of Chihuahua."

> In the event there was a violation of any law, action must be taken. If any
> official of her government acted wrongly, let it proceed.
>
> Claudia Sheinbaum

On Friday, from Irapuato, Guanajuato, President Claudia Sheinbaum said that,
despite the **significant differences she has had with the governor of
Chihuahua** , María Eugenia Campos, over the participation of Central
Intelligence Agency (CIA) agents in an anti-drug operation in the state, she
would meet with her today at the Ciudad Juárez airport, but that it would be
with the Secretary of Governance, Rosa Icela Rodríguez, that the PAN governor
would take up state-related matters.

"She sent me a letter requesting a series of meetings, taking advantage of my
visit to Chihuahua. The truth is I am going to the (accountability) event and
from there I am off to Baja California," she said.

She emphasized that she asked the Secretary of Governance to speak with her.
"They will have several meetings on the issues she is requesting through the
Secretariat of Governance in Mexico City," she affirmed.
